# AI for Babies
> Early childhood learning tools and personalized educational storytelling powered by ethical AI.

## Focus Areas
- Personalized Children's Stories: Audio and illustrated stories tailored to your child's developmental stage.
- Gentle AI Learning: Screen-time conscious, audio-first interactive activities for toddlers.
